510(k) Number (if known)
K141227
Device Name
Polaris Pressure Adjustable Valve System / Polaris Adjustable Valve with SiphonX / Polaris Adjustment Kit
Indications for Use (Describe)
The Polaris® Adjustable Pressure Valve is designed for the treatment of hydrocephalus by shunting the Cerebrospinal
Fluid (CSF) to the abdominal cavity or right atrium of the heart.
Type of Use (Select one or both, as applicable)
Prescription Use (Part 21 CFR 801 Subpart D) Over-The-Counter Use (21 CFR 801 Subpart C)
